description: This file defines the `ResourceOptimizedPlacementOptions` class, which contains configuration settings for resource-aware placement of grains across a cluster, including weights for CPU, memory, and activation count, along with validation logic to ensure configuration values are within the expected range.

classes.name: ResourceOptimizedPlacementOptions
classes.description: A sealed class encapsulating various resource-based placement weights and preferences used in grain placement strategies within Orleans framework.

classes.name: ResourceOptimizedPlacementOptionsValidator
classes.description: An internal sealed class implementing configuration validation for ResourceOptimizedPlacementOptions, ensuring all weights are within valid bounds.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the resource weight configurations to ensure they are within [0-100], throwing exceptions if any values are out of range.
